lessons.title: Xin lùi hạn bàn giao API
lessons.script:
A: Hey Alex, do you have a quick sec? Regarding the API integration roadmap, we might run into a slight delay.
B: Oh, really? I thought we were on track for Friday's deployment.
A: Well, the third-party doc was outdated, so it took us longer than expected to debug. Long story short, we need two extra days to run proper end-to-end tests.
B: I see. Can you drop a quick update on Slack so the product team stays in the loop?
lessons.slack_email: Hi team, quick heads-up: due to some outdated API docs, we need to push the deployment back by 2 days for testing. Revised ETA is next Tuesday. Thanks for understanding!
lessons.reflection:
A: Hey Sarah, regarding the UI design concept, we might run into a slight delay.
B: Drop a quick update on Slack so the marketing team stays in the loop.

lessons.topic: Báo cáo & Xử lý sự cố
lessons.title: Báo cáo sự cố Downtime hệ thống
lessons.script:
A: Heads up, team! We've noticed a spike in latency on the authentication service.
B: Are users experiencing complete downtime or just slow response times?
A: It's mostly slow load times, but error rates are starting to creep up. Long story short, the database connection pool is maxed out.
B: Got it. Let's spin up additional read replicas immediately to lighten the load.
lessons.slack_email: Urgent update: Auth service is experiencing high latency due to DB pool exhaustion. We are currently spinning up extra read replicas. Next update in 15 mins.
lessons.reflection:
A: Heads up, team! We've noticed a memory leak in the payment gateway service.
B: Let me know if you need an extra hands on deck.

lessons.title: Đề xuất cắt giảm tính năng trong Sprint
lessons.script:
A: Looking at our current velocity, we won't be able to deliver all scope items this sprint.
B: That's concerning. What do you propose we push to the backlog?
A: I suggest we descope the dark mode feature and focus purely on core checkout optimization. That way, we guarantee on-time delivery.
B: Makes sense. Let's align with the PM before finalizing the sprint goal.
lessons.slack_email: Hi all, after evaluating sprint velocity, we propose moving dark mode to the backlog to secure core checkout features for release. Please review and approve.
lessons.reflection:
A: Looking at our roadmap, we won't be able to finish the export feature this quarter.
B: Let's align with stakeholders before making a final decision.

lessons.title: Nhờ Review PR (Pull Request) gấp
lessons.script:
A: Sorry to bother you, David. Could you take a look at PR #204 when you get a chance?
B: Sure thing. Is there any blocker holding up the deployment?
A: Yeah, the QA team needs this hotfix in staging before they can run regression tests.
B: Say no more. I'll review and approve it within the hour.
lessons.slack_email: Hey David, PR #204 with the hotfix is ready for review. Need your stamp on it so QA can start regression testing. Thanks!
lessons.reflection:
A: Could you take a look at the contract draft when you get a chance?
B: I'll review and approve it by EOD.

lessons.title: Giao công việc Onboarding cho Dev mới
lessons.script:
A: Welcome aboard, Kevin! For your first week, we'd like you to get familiar with our codebase.
B: Thanks! Should I start with the setup documentation on Confluence?
A: Exactly. Go through the setup guide, build the project locally, and let me know if you hit any roadblocks.
B: Sounds like a plan. I'll give you a ping if I get stuck.
lessons.slack_email: Welcome Kevin! Please follow the setup guide on Confluence to get your local environment running. Ping me on Slack if you hit any roadblocks.
lessons.reflection:
A: Go through the architecture doc and let me know if you hit any roadblocks.
B: Sounds like a plan. I'll ping you if I need clarification.

lessons.title: Báo hết tải công việc (Bandwidth)
lessons.script:
A: Hey, can you take on the user permissions refactoring task for this iteration?
B: To be frank, my bandwidth is completely stretched thin with the security audit.
A: Ah, I see. If I reassign the audit report, could you manage it?
B: In that case, yes. That would clear up enough headroom for me to take it over.
lessons.slack_email: Hi team, my current bandwidth is fully allocated to the security audit. If we can adjust priorities, I can take over the refactoring task.
lessons.reflection:
A: To be frank, my bandwidth is completely stretched thin with the Q3 planning.
B: Let's adjust priorities so we don't burn out the team.

lessons.topic: Báo cáo & Xử lý sự cố
lessons.title: Xử lý xung đột code merge
lessons.script:
A: We're running into major merge conflicts after pulling the latest main branch.
B: Did the breaking changes come from the payment refactoring module?
A: Exactly. The function signatures were completely changed without notice.
B: Let's set up a quick huddle with the backend lead to resolve this together.
lessons.slack_email: Team, we hit merge conflicts on main due to updated payment module signatures. Jumping into a quick huddle now to resolve it.
lessons.reflection:
A: We're running into major merge conflicts on the staging server.
B: Let's set up a quick huddle to sort it out.

lessons.title: Báo cáo tiến độ Daily Standup
lessons.script:
A: What did you work on yesterday, and do you have any blockers today?
B: Yesterday I finished setting up the CI/CD pipeline for the staging environment.
A: Great! Anything standing in your way for today's task?
B: No blockers on my end. Today I'm diving into unit testing for the auth module.
lessons.slack_email: Standup update: Yesterday completed staging CI/CD pipeline. Today working on auth unit tests. No blockers currently.
lessons.reflection:
A: Yesterday I finished optimizing the database queries.
B: No blockers on my end, proceeding with API testing today.

lessons.title: Xác nhận yêu cầu thay đổi từ Client

B: Definitely. I'll draft an email highlighting the discrepancies first.
lessons.slack_email: Hi Client, we received your feedback. To ensure alignment with technical specs, we drafted a brief comparison and would like a 10-min call.
lessons.reflection:
A: Good catch, some points contradict our agreed scope.
B: I'll draft an email highlighting the main discrepancies.

B: Perfect. Enjoy your time off! We'll ping Mark if anything urgent comes up.
lessons.slack_email: OOO Notice: I will be away starting Thursday. Mark will cover urgent infrastructure issues in my absence. Thanks!
lessons.reflection:
A: Mark will be covering my responsibilities while I'm on leave.
B: Perfect. We'll ping him if anything urgent comes up.

lessons.title: Đàm phán cắt bớt Scope sản phẩm
lessons.script:
A: If we keep all these requirements, we're definitely going to miss the hard launch date.
B: What are our options if moving the launch date is off the table?
A: We can launch with MVP features first, then roll out Phase 2 in the following release.
B: That works for me. Let's get buy-in from the product director.
lessons.slack_email: Hi all, to meet the hard launch date, we recommend releasing MVP features first. Phase 2 features will follow in the next release cycle.
lessons.reflection:
A: If moving the deadline is off the table, we should reduce the scope.
B: Let's get buy-in from stakeholders before proceeding.

lessons.topic: Báo cáo & Xử lý sự cố
lessons.title: Rò rỉ dữ liệu / Lỗi bảo mật
lessons.script:
A: Our monitoring system flagged an unusual number of unauthorized API requests.
B: Is there any indication that user data was compromised?
A: Not at first glance, but we revoked the leaked API keys immediately to be safe.
B: Good call. Let's draft an incident report for internal review.
lessons.slack_email: Security Alert: Revoked compromised API keys after detecting abnormal traffic. No data compromise detected. Incident report to follow.
lessons.reflection:
A: We revoked the access tokens immediately to play it safe.
B: Good call, let's draft an incident summary.

lessons.title: Bất đồng ý kiến trong thiết kế System
lessons.script:
A: I'm not entirely convinced that switching to microservices is necessary at this stage.
B: Why so? A monolith won't scale with our projected user growth next year.
A: True, but microservices introduce huge operational overhead for our small team.
B: You bring up a valid point. Let's weigh the pros and cons in a RFC doc.
lessons.slack_email: Hi team, created an RFC doc to evaluate Monolith vs Microservices architecture for our next phase. Please add your inputs.
lessons.reflection:
A: You bring up a valid point regarding maintenance overhead.
B: Let's weigh the pros and cons before making a decision.

lessons.script:
A: Just wanted to give a huge shoutout to Sarah for resolving that production bug yesterday!
B: Absolutely, her quick response saved us from a massive outage.
A: It really showed great initiative. We should highlight this in the team demo.
B: Agreed! Kudo cards sent her way.
lessons.slack_email: Huge shoutout to Sarah for fixing the prod issue quickly! Exceptional work keeping our downtime to a minimum.
lessons.reflection:
A: Huge shoutout to the frontend team for delivering on time!
B: It really showed great initiative across the board.

B: Let's isolate the code snippet and push a hotfix directly to production.

lessons.reflection:
A: It seems like a browser compatibility issue on older versions.

B: Let's vote on feasibility versus impact using an Effort-Matrix.
A: Great idea. That will quickly highlight the low-hanging fruit.
B: Exactly. Let's spend 5 minutes dot-voting on the top 3 items.
lessons.slack_email: Brainstorming summary: Selected top 3 high-impact features based on effort matrix. Detailed doc attached.
lessons.reflection:
A: That will quickly highlight the low-hanging fruit for this quarter.
B: Exactly, let's focus on high-impact items first.
